inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. inputs.modified_text: This looks less like an oversight and more like a protected arrangement: illegal mining continues, KTR says the company is linked to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, and the Congress government is accused of looking away. The allegation may be only part of the picture, but that’s precisely why the rush to manage the story feels telling. When powerful interests might benefit, silence and distraction can do the work of protection.
